answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Hadith & Sunnah Question ID: 150301 Country: india Title: Can we kiss to our thumb when the name of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (saws) comes? Question: Can we kiss to our thumb when the name of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (saws) comes? Answer ID: 150301 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 838/768/SD=8/1438) No! It is not proved to kiss the thumb when the name of the Holy Prophet Muhammad (saws) is chanted. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
